subject: Whistic tenant access rotation and escrow guidance
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@whistic.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@acme-secops.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant access rotation - upload keys and evidence request

Hi Dylan,

Quick note from the Whistic onboarding team: we flagged that Acme's tenant for Redwood is still using a long-lived S3 upload key tied to the staging manifest. For security hygiene we recommend rotating tenant keys and updating the Whistic connector to use the new credential before the next bulk upload window.

Requests:
- Can Redwood rotate the staging upload key and provide the new key name + expiration? Prefer a short TTL (<=48h) for the next upload.
- Please upload the latest SOC 2 report (redacted okay) and the access manifest to your Whistic profile. That will allow our automated verifier to map S3 ownership.
- If you have a break-glass process or ephemeral token pattern, include a short note so our reviewers can mark the control as implemented.

We can accept evidence as attachments here or via the tenant portal. If helpful, I attached our onboarding checklist.

Thanks,
Olivia
Whistic Onboarding

Attachments: Whistic_onboarding_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: Tenant access rotation - upload keys and evidence request

Olivia — thanks for the heads up. Looping in Mina (platform security) to drop the SOC 2 and the manifest into the Whistic profile, and Jonas (integrations) to schedule the short TTL rotation for the staging upload key.

Plan we propose: 
- Today: Mina uploads SOC2 summary + whistic_access_manifest_20260731.json to your portal and shares the Drive link.
- Tomorrow morning (2026-08-03 09:00 PT): Jonas will rotate the staging key and provision a temporary TTLed key for the scheduled bulk upload window. He'll post the key name and expiry in the tenant notes.
- We'll also include a short note on our break-glass workflow for staging artifacts.

Mina / Jonas — can you confirm ETA on the uploads and rotation? Samir — flag if Acme security wants an earlier rotation window.

Thanks,
Dylan
Director, Platform Partnerships
